tasks.title: Diagnose & Fix PowerPoint Discarding addSection XML
tasks.description: Resolve the root causes preventing sections created via addSection(name, startSlideIndex) from rendering in PowerPoint: (1) Ensure contiguous partitioning across all slides in ppt/presentation.xml (creating a 'Default Section' if startSlideIndex > 1), (2) Map numerical slide IDs (<p14:sldId id='...'/>) extracted from <p:sldIdLst> rather than 1-based indices or relationship IDs, (3) Register uppercase GUIDs wrapped in braces (id='{...}'), (4) Wrap in <p:extLst> with URI '{521415D9-36F7-43E2-AB2F-B90AF26B5E84}' and xmlns:p14 namespace, and (5) Ensure <p:extLst> is written as the final child before </p:presentation>.
